ocr.notes: Close to the image. Small differences: 'Thomas F. Rowe' is 'Thomas P. Rowe' in print; John Daly's time reads 'about 1 o'clock Sunday morning', not 11; 'Ninth and Market sts.'; Lyons' quote ends 'I'm game, ain't I?'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that a coroner's jury found Tom Allen's killing of Timothy Confoy in his saloon justifiable homicide, after witnesses testified that Confoy had a revolver and was drawing it when Allen fired.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Tuesday Evening, St. Louis, February 28, 1899, front page.

facts.fact: Allen shot and killed Timothy Confoy in his saloon and concert hall early Sunday morning, after an argument over a drink; Confoy fell on a revolver borrowed earlier that night
places: Allen's saloon, Market Street, St. Louis

facts.fact: A coroner's jury under Coroner Lloyd returned a verdict of justifiable homicide after 10 minutes; Allen was represented by Judge Harvey and Thomas P. Rowe
Per witness John Spencer, Allen warned Confoy before shooting
facts.quote: You've come in here for trouble, and you've got a gun in your pocket. If you attempt to draw it I'll kill you.

notes: The street of the saloon is not named in this article; Market Street comes from other items (fact 011). Quote is secondhand testimony, hence medium.
